title: Injective launches onchain futures market tracking Nvidia GPU rental costs
description: The new index tracks rental prices for five Nvidia GPUs, offering leveraged trading and potential hedging against fluctuations in AI computing costs. ]]>

title: AI Agents Are Creating a New Layer of Cybersecurity Spending
description: Akamai launched a locked box for AI agents on Tuesday. It joins Palo Alto, Cisco, CrowdStrike, Okta and Zscaler in selling protection for software that now acts on its own.

title: Phantom launches Kalshi-powered prediction markets for US users
description: The crypto wallet’s new integration offers CFTC-regulated event contracts through Kalshi, as prediction markets face growing legal challenges in the US. ]]>

title: Chip Maker SK Hynix Posts Record Quarter as AI Memory Demand Overwhelms Supply
description: SK Hynix's quarterly revenue topped 100 trillion won for the first time, and the chipmaker says memory demand will outrun supply through 2030, with DRAM and HBM sold out through 2029.

title: Polygon Extends Its Stablecoin Payments Infrastructure to Solana
description: The expansion gives Solana businesses one integration to connect bank funding, embedded wallets, cross-chain transfers and global payouts, with cross-border firm Kira among the first adopters.

title: Polymarket Pauses Trading as Prediction Market Investigates Security Incident
description: Polymarket restricted trading and paused relayer actions as users report funds leaving their accounts. A suspected attacker wallet holds about $2.65 million in POL, per Arkham data.

title: EIP-7702 didn’t cause Binance hack, but may have amplified losses
description: Security experts said attackers could have drained Binance’s wallets without EIP-7702, but the Ethereum upgrade may have helped bypass withdrawal safeguards. ]]>

title: Worried About Crypto Hacks? Buy Bitcoin Proxies in Stock Market Instead, Say Wall Street Firms
description: Analysts at Cantor Fitzgerald, TD Cowen and Compass Point say the record $6.4 billion theft is a Binance security failure, not a crypto-wide threat, pointing clients toward proxies like Coinbase, Robinhood, and Strategy.
